calls.summary:
# Renewal Process Requirements Gathering
Date: 2026-10-23 | Duration: 28m

## Summary
The discussion addressed how to separate PepsiCo United States, PepsiCo India, Gatorade, Pepsi, and other brands when teams, budgets, or renewal timing differ, while generally keeping GrowthBook teams under one company. Renewal dates should be anchored to contract end dates, with a cutover decision needed for late-signature renewals and existing anniversary inconsistencies. Annual terms remain preferred, while multi-year and unusual terms require exception logic. Renewal and expansion ARR should reflect full recurring run rate for forecasting, while HubSpot and order forms retain prorated billing values. Proposed reporting should distinguish ARR, services revenue, TCV, ATR terminology, and one-time revenue, subject to Finance validation. Workflow requirements include updating open renewals when coterminated expansions close, formalizing renewal ownership with Ryan, standardizing renewal deal types, and addressing contraction handling. Jeff will document the design before technical specifications, build, testing, user acceptance testing, and a team demo. A 30-minute follow-up will cover contraction and auto-renewal logic.

## Keywords
Renewal automation, HubSpot data model, Contract end dates, ARR and TCV, Coterminated expansions, Contraction revenue
